kai: quick share — ran a kernel-choice heatmap across H100/A100/L40s, seq len sweep 512..8192 and batch sweep 1..16. looking for obvious KV-cache interactions and a couple of p99 spikes we saw in prod. attaching highlights below

kai: run command: `./bench/attn_sweep --model vicuna-13b --kernels flash_v2,fused_attn,paged_attn --devices h100,a100,l40s --seqs 512,1024,2048,4096,8192 --batches 1,2,4,8,16 --kvcache true`

bench-bot: results uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-perf/attn_heatmap/1837654321/ (csv + flamegraphs) :white_check_mark:

bench-bot: summary (median token/sec):
- H100: flash_v2 best at short seqs (512-2048), fused_attn wins at 4096 for batch >=4, paged_attn stable for 8192 but lower throughput
- A100: fused_attn generally best across mid seqs, flash_v2 falls off earlier than H100
- L40S: paged_attn surprisingly competitive at 4096/8192 when batch >=8 (memory savings)

jamie: interesting — any KV cache spill patterns? prod p99 looked like KV spill+memcpy at seq ~4096 on H100

sasha: checked flamegraphs for the H100 4096 x batch8 case. kernel selection was switching to fused_attn, but we had frequent host<->device memcpy for KV prefetch when cache miss rate > ~12%

sasha: snippet from perf probe:
```
# H100, seq=4096, batch=8
memcpy_host_to_device: 42ms total
compute_kernel_fused: 18ms per token
compute_kernel_flash: 22ms per token
cache_lookup: 3ms (hot) / 15ms (miss+prefetch)
```

kai: so fused_attn wins compute but hurts when kv cache miss causes repeated memcpy. that matches p99 spikes. any idea why fused triggers more prefetches?

jamie: hypothesis: fused path uses a different tile layout that doesn't align with our KV chunk boundaries, so we trigger extra prefetch for cross-tile keys. need to check tiling config and the kvcache shard boundaries.

sasha: i instrumented kvcache lookup counts — for fused_attn at seq4096/b8 we see ~1.3x more prefetch ops vs flash_v2. paged_attn kept prefetch ops low but higher compute per token (hence lower throughput at small batches).

kai: proposal: add a quick heuristic in kernel selector — if kvcache_miss_rate > 10% and memcpy_time_share > 25% then prefer paged_attn or flash_v2 with conservative tiling. fallback TTL 60s. thoughts? :thinking:

jamie: sounds reasonable. also add a flag to force tile-aligned kvcache boundaries for fused kernel experiments (`--force-kv-align`) so we can test without changing selector heuristics.

sasha: will run a targeted sweep with `--force-kv-align` on H100 only (seq 2048,4096,8192, batch 4,8) and push results by EOD. if it reduces prefetch ops -> we can consider a kernel-specific tiling patch.

infra-bot: scheduled job: perf-run-1837654321-align-sweep on h100-pool (ETA ~40m). logs -> /ci/artifacts/1837654321-align

kai: great — if aligned config fixes it we can add selector rule + checkbox in console for "KV-aligned fused kernel" behind an experiment flag. also note to perf docs: add guidance about L40S "paged wins at high seq+batch" case.

bench-bot: quick note: end-to-end latency p99 for H100 fused_attn seq4096/b8 before alignment = 152ms, after initial aligned run (early) = 98ms. preliminary but promising.

jamie: wow that delta is nice. once sasha finishes full sweep let's create a small PR for kernel selector + rollout plan (canary: 5% traffic to fused+align)

sasha: will dump csvs & flamegraphs to s3 path above and ping here when done.

kai: thanks team — good debugging loop. followups: sasha run, jamie PR draft, i'll add console checkbox mockup.

bench-bot: thread closed when all artifacts uploaded. "perf-run-1837654321-align" -> status: queued -> running -> uploaded.
